events.title: 美国能源部拟出资19亿美元资助26州31个输电项目，称可释放逾23GW容量
events.caveats: 1) Timing: the DOE release is dated 2026-09-24 US time (exact hour not shown) and Bloomberg/Utility Dive/mgrid/RTO Insider coverage is also dated 09-24, so the primary event most likely occurred a few hours BEFORE the window start (2026-09-25 06:00 Beijing = 09-24 18:00 ET); the DCD and The Register pieces (09-25) fall inside the window. in_window=true is based on those 09-25 reports; editor may treat as prior-day news. 2) Status: these are selections / 'intention to help fund', not executed awards; PDF says details are subject to change pending formal financial assistance agreements. A search-result summary claimed agreements are expected Oct 2026–Jan 2027, but no fetched page confirms this; mgrid states DOE has not published a schedule. 3) Rounding: '$1.9bn' vs PDF line-item sum $1,893,241,306; '$5.25bn' vs sum $5,251,893,508; Utility Dive rounds cost share to ~$3.4bn and total to $5.3bn. 4) '23+ GW' is DOE's aggregate claim with no per-project breakdown or methodology disclosed; no completion dates disclosed. 5) The 'to speed data center connections' framing is DCD's; the DOE release itself emphasizes lower electricity costs and reliability. Only some narratives explicitly cite data centers (Alabama Power, Entergy Mississippi, TVA title) or large-load interconnection (Indiana, Ohio PUCO, Pitch Aeronautics, Duquesne Light). 6) DCD page could not be fetched (HTTP 403); its details were taken from the search snippet.

events.caveats: 1) 核心说法（10月中旬定稿生效、100MW超大规模门槛、工业类须进工业园区、能源部定用电上限）已由The Nation、THE STANDARD、Thansettakij三家泰国媒体9月20日报道相互印证，DCD 9月25日文章明确以The Nation为来源；但未找到NESDC或泰国政府的原始文件/新闻稿，Danucha表态的具体场合和日期各报道均未说明。2) 事件与首次报道均为9月20日，不在观察窗口内；仅DCD英文转述（9月25日）落在窗口内。3) “10月中旬”是目标时点而非已生效规则；100MW门槛是Danucha的建议，最终待委员会审定。4) 线索中猜测的Bangkok Post并非来源。5) Thansettakij摘要提到2MW以上归为工业类须进工业园区、The Nation 9月5日报道称现行2MW门槛正在重新考虑，此点未逐字核实，未纳入事实字段。6) 聚合网站pectecth称曼谷备用燃料储存许可自9月2日起冻结，未从原始来源核实。7) BOI上半年88个项目、8860亿泰铢数字来自DCD转述，未直接核对BOI原始发布。

events.caveats: 1) 时间归属：季报于9月24日提交交易所（窗口外），窗口内事项为9月25日的分析员反应报道（BusinessToday 10:19北京时间；星洲日报20:49）。2) 第四季"3亿至4亿令吉数据中心土地销售进项"及"KNBDC 2.808亿令吉于2027财年上半年认列"仅来自星洲日报转述RHB研究，BusinessToday文章被CAPTCHA拦截未能读取；NST 9月23日"CGS International预期1.67亿令吉盈利贡献"仅见标题未核实。3) Tera有条件买卖协议未见于ECOWLD或SD Guthrie 9月18-25日的Bursa公告列表，仅由The Star、星洲、FMT报道确认；面积The Star写221.665英亩、星洲写221.655英亩；星洲摘要称地块位于"Selangor Vision Valley 2.0 C区"，疑为马来西亚愿景谷2.0（森美兰），The Star称波德申Mukim Jimah。4) "KNBDC"买方身份公司未披露，2.808亿令吉与2026年4月古来QUANTUM Edge交易金额一致。5) 季报数字取自KLSE Screener镜像的Bursa公告，同比百分比取自FMT。6) 本次WebSearch配额耗尽，来源发现依赖Google News RSS，可能遗漏其他报道。
